title: Flow fields
caption: portable_seed7: direct PINN fields at t=1. Vorticity computed by plotting-grid differences. Uncertainty and residuals must be checked before quantitative interpretation.

title: Channel profile
caption: portable_seed7: final profile at channel midpoint. The dashed initial unladen profile is not a two-way validation target.

title: Speed surface
caption: portable_seed7: height encodes speed over the solved x–y plane; the vertical axis is a field value, not a third spatial coordinate.

title: Transport snapshots
caption: portable_seed7: four direct evaluations of PINN fluid and parcel states. Marker radii are illustrative. Colors use one common speed scale.

title: Parcel paths
caption: portable_seed7: direct PINN parcel trajectories; open markers denote initial states and filled markers denote final states. No boundary clipping is applied.

title: Channel view
caption: portable_seed7: extruded illustration of a 2D solution; every particle has z=0. Display depth contains no solved physics.

title: Parcel velocities
caption: portable_seed7: PINN velocity outputs. Kinematic consistency with position derivatives is audited separately.

title: Conservation diagnostics
caption: portable_seed7: driven channel includes wall viscous and pressure tractions, body force and particle gravity. Total momentum and energy need not be constant. Quadrature errors enter global balances. Contact cases omit unsupported global balances.

title: Parcel transport
caption: portable_seed7: PINN positions, periodic wrapping in x. Marker sizes are illustrative, not physical radii.

title: Parameter effects
caption: Parcel-mean velocities by case. Multiple-seed shading, when present, is ±1 sample standard deviation; it is not a confidence bound or a discretization error estimate.
